coverage: 2000-present: structured Governor archive from 2020, plus 35 weather emergency orders added by hand: 7 Bush orders from 2000-2003 read one at a time from the State Library order archive (edocs.dos.fl.gov), which disallows crawlers and is not crawled; Bush and Crist orders from 2004-2010 catalogued with their dates by the FSU College of Law collection on Florida Government Documents; and 2005-2019 declarations dated from the order copies kept by FMCSA, the Division of Emergency Management and DEP, archived Governor pages, and news coverage. No state declaration was found for DR-1381 (Tropical Storm Allison, 2001), DR-1595 (Dennis, 2005) or DR-4138 (July 2013 flooding). EM-3259 (Rita, 2005) counts as matched only because its incident period runs into the Wilma declaration, and DR-1481 (June to August 2003 flooding) only because the August 2003 Palm Beach County tornado order falls inside its incident period
